posts.author: tototome
posts.body:
Hihi! I'm totome
! I have been using rpgmaker since around the 2010s? And I first started on RPGMAKER VXACE.
My favorite engine is RPG Maker 2003, but i'm learning how to use MV and MZ right now. I used to make a lot of tiny beginner games, but I forgot a lot of information. I joined this thread to get support help. I was inspired by Yume Nikki & other RPG Horror games of the 2000s.
I own every single rpgmaker engine! And hope to one day learn OHRRPGCE and Wolf RPG.
I mainly digitally paint, but I hope I can improve on pixel art.

posts.author: tototome
posts.body:
MrDummyAcc_dot said:
Never heard of OHRRPGCE, there's a game engine for everyone I guess.
Click to expand...
Haha, OHRRPGCE is pretty niche I think? I love the retro look of it, and the engine has some neat features though. The one I find most useful is passability mode, since it's convenient for laying out maps. I think that there's plugins that exist for RPG maker that do similar though.
The game I found out about it from personally was SPLENDID LAND's Megaman Sprite Game.
